description: Wire the Exam Plan page to use real PracticeAttempt data instead of generic session data. Show actual per-subject scores from the seeded attempts (Corporate Issuers 76%, FSA 69%, PM 78%, QM 78%, Alt Inv 79%), calculate weighted CFA readiness score, and provide subject-specific daily targets based on weak areas.
steps: In src/features/exam-plan/components/exam-plan-content.tsx (after FEAT-001 has replaced useSyncExternalStore): Import getAllAttempts from '@/features/question-bank/utils/attempt-storage' and loadAllQuestions from the question-loader. Read PracticeAttempt data in a useState lazy initializer.

Replace the generic 'subjectProgress' computation (which just distributes session attempts evenly across 'All Subjects') with real per-subject data from PracticeAttempts. For each of the 10 CFA subjects, show: accuracy percentage from attempt data, number of questions answered, and coverage (questions answered / total available in that subject).

Update the metrics calculation to use CFA_CURRICULUM_WEIGHTS for a weighted readiness score. Replace the generic '2000 questions' target with the actual total available questions (1,283). Calculate questions/day based on unanswered questions remaining.
Add a 'Focus Areas' section that highlights the 3 weakest subjects (lowest accuracy) with specific module-level breakdowns showing which modules need the most work.
Run bun run tsc --noEmit to verify.
acceptance_criteria: Subject Progress shows real accuracy percentages from PracticeAttempt data (not generic session data)
Predicted/readiness score uses CFA curriculum weights
Daily targets are calculated from actual remaining questions and days until exam
Focus Areas section shows the 3 weakest subjects with module breakdowns
verification: Run: bun run tsc --noEmit - expect exit 0
Run: bun run vitest --run - expect same or better pass count
findings: Successfully wired exam plan to real data. Replaced hardcoded 2000 question target with actual getQuestionCountBySubject(). Used getAllAttempts() for per-subject accuracy. Added weighted readiness score using CFA_CURRICULUM_WEIGHTS. Added Focus Areas section showing 3 weakest subjects with module-level breakdowns. TypeScript passes clean, all non-env tests pass (261/261).
